Definition: from G1125; a document, i.e. holy Writ (or its contents or a statement in it):--scripture.
BiblicalUsage: graphḗ is a plain word for scripture. In Matthew 21:42, the text says "Did ye never read in the scriptures." In Mark 12:10, the text says "And have ye not read this scripture."
TheologicalSignificance: What graphḗ teaches me is that God's Word means what it says, and this word is part of how He speaks plainly to us. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Rejected at Nazareth; The Cleansing of the Temple; The Parable of the Wicked Tenants
